Words and recordsSeen come only from summary fields (glTF nodeCount/primitiveCount/projectedPositions/missingCompanionCount/unsupportedPrimitiveCount/globalPlacement; OBJ vertexCount/polygonCount/unsupportedStatementCount/missingCompanionDeclarationCount/axes/units/crs). delivery.boundary: Readings stay candidate evidence, unplaced: no geometry layer, record, package, card target, measurement or right. A glTF has no CRS field and its summary states globalPlacement unknown; an OBJ summary states crs unknown; the words say the model stays unplaced and why.

decisions: recordsSeen is the glTF nodeCount and the OBJ polygonCount, as DXF uses recordCount.
The settle lookup matches the item's card format against the reader's card formats (glb or gltf for one glTF job).
Existing DXF/CityGML/CityJSON job ids are unchanged: the reader key equals their card format.
No processor change: the glTF/OBJ host readers receive bytes the Node worker reads from storage; no Python key pattern exists. imageRebuildNeeded false.

runtime.note: Both readers are pinned Windows-host profiles (gltf-config/obj-config). Where no profile is configured the job queues with tools null; when a dispatcher runs it, the worker settles the item as stopped with its code (for example GLTF_UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM). Dispatch of gltf-native/obj-native jobs on a runtime was not qualified here. GLTF_CODE_FILES/OBJ code pins include the changed files, so jobs pinned before this change read as changed tools.
